destinations.name: Dhilba Guuranda-Innes National Park
destinations.coordinates_source: candidate: Wikipedia area point (park centroid); needs the visitor point (visitor centre / campground)

name_evidence.wording: Dhilba Guuranda-Innes National Park, the headline Yorke attraction (Ethel wreck, lighthouses, surf, walks)

spots.bio: Museum in the old Smith stump-jump plough factory, with a Zanoni shipwreck display.
spots.name: Ardrossan Heritage Museum
spots.note: Two sources: yorkepeninsula.com.au and visityorkepeninsula.com.au museums page (in the old Smith stump-jump plough factory, shipwreck Zanoni display, open seven days 10-4).

spots.bio: 1878 schoolroom in Stansbury holding farm and industry displays, open only some afternoons.
spots.name: Stansbury Museum
spots.note: Two counted sources (Wikivoyage Stansbury See; visityorkepeninsula.com.au museums page): 1878 schoolroom with farm and industry displays. Objection: volunteer-run, open Wed and Sun afternoons.

spots.bio: Museum in a former produce store covering the salt industry and shipwrecks, open at weekends.
spots.name: Edithburgh Museum
spots.note: Two counted sources: Wikivoyage Edithburgh See (adults $3) and the visityorkepeninsula.com.au museums page (salt industry, shipwrecks, produce-store building). Objection: weekend afternoons only.

spots.bio: Private museum with a large WWI, WWII and Vietnam collection and memorial gardens.
spots.name: Bublacowie Military Museum
spots.note: Two sources: visityorkepeninsula.com.au museums page (extensive WWI/WWII/Vietnam collection, memorial gardens, tours) and History SA; guided visits last an hour or two. Objection: private museum, open Sun to Tue or by appointment.

spots.bio: Lighthouse and lookout on Cape Spencer, also the park's whale-watching cliff.
spots.name: Cape Spencer Lighthouse
spots.note: Lighthouse and lookout on Cape Spencer in Innes National Park, named by parks.sa.gov.au and yorkepeninsula.com.au (Cape Spencer Lookout); also the park's whale-watching cliff. One spot with Cape Spencer (duplicate).

spots.bio: Surf beach and campground at the western end of the park.
spots.name: Pondalowie Bay
spots.note: Surf beach and campground in the park, named by parks.sa.gov.au and yorkepeninsula.com.au; a beach (and Yorke's best-known surf break) is a standard second-tier keep.

spots.bio: Remains of the 1904 wreck of the Ethel on Ethel Beach.
spots.name: Ethel Wreck
spots.note: Remains of the Ethel (1904) on Ethel Beach in the park, named by parks.sa.gov.au ('Visit... the shipwreck of the Ethel') and yorkepeninsula.com.au (rules 1, 2). Ethel Beach is a duplicate of this.

spots.bio: Headland lookout reached by a 4 km return walk with views of the rugged coast.
spots.name: Royston Head
spots.note: Headland lookout, 2-hour 4 km return hike with 'amazing views of the rugged peninsula coast' (parks.sa.gov.au); a headland a guide singles out, second tier but real.

spots.bio: Village in the park with the visitor centre, jetty and campground.
spots.name: Stenhouse Bay
spots.note: Village in Dhilba Guuranda-Innes National Park with the visitor centre, jetty, campground and whale-watching cliffs; named by yorkepeninsula.com.au and the parks page (rules 1, 2). Stands in for Stenhouse Bay Jetty (duplicate).

spots.bio: 1 km loop to West Cape lighthouse with 360 degree views.
spots.name: West Cape Headland Hike
spots.note: 30-minute 1 km loop to West Cape lighthouse with 360 degree views, named on parks.sa.gov.au and highlighted by rangers (rules 1, 2).

spots.bio: Abandoned gypsum township with ruins, interpretive signs and heritage cottages.
spots.name: Inneston
spots.note: Abandoned gypsum township in the park, a named see on the parks.sa.gov.au page (ruins, interpretive signs, heritage cottages); one spot with Inneston Historic Walk (duplicate of this).

spots.bio: 2 km cliff-top loop with views over Investigator Strait.
spots.name: Stenhouse Bay Lookout Walk
spots.note: parks.sa.gov.au lists it as an easy 1 hour, 2 km cliff-top loop with views over Investigator Strait "among the best in the park"; a distinct walk from the jetty car park.
